about.text: I'm an Electronics & Telecommunication engineering student at MITS Gwalior and a self-driven full-stack developer. I've built and deployed a real-time chat application and interactive JavaScript games, I sharpen my DSA skills every day, and as an IEEE technical team member I love building with others. I'm also learning Japanese to get ready for global tech opportunities.

whatIDo.title: Full-Stack Development
whatIDo.text: Building complete web apps — Node.js backends, real-time communication and responsive JavaScript interfaces.

whatIDo.title: Problem Solving & DSA
whatIDo.text: Breaking problems into clean logic. I practise data structures and algorithms and take part in coding contests.

whatIDo.title: Tools & Data
whatIDo.text: Shipping with a proper workflow — Git, deployment, and Power BI dashboards that turn data into insight.

projects.title: Real-Time Chat Application
projects.description: A full-stack chat app where messages reach every connected user instantly — no page refresh needed.
points: Node.js backend handling persistent, two-way communication
Version-controlled with Git and deployed live on Render

projects.title: Tic-Tac-Toe Game
projects.description: A two-player browser game with win detection, reset and new-game controls, built in vanilla JavaScript.
points: Game-state logic and dynamic DOM updates without any framework
Refactored conditional logic to remove runtime glitches
Fully responsive with smooth, event-driven animations

projects.title: Currency Converter
projects.description: Converts an amount between currencies, with country flags that change as you pick a currency.
points: From / To currency selection with live flag updates
Shows the exchange rate alongside the result

projects.title: Rock-Paper-Scissors
projects.description: A quick player-vs-computer game with score tracking, built with vanilla JavaScript.
points: Random computer moves and instant result logic
Event-driven UI with smooth feedback animations
